1.title: Configuring the Sentinel Platform: Roles, Data Tiers, Workbooks and SOC Optimization
1.text: Welcome to Module six: Configuring the Sentinel Platform: Roles, Data Tiers, Workbooks and sock Optimization. It covers the exam area one. Manage a security operations environment. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do five things. Specify Microsoft Sentinel roles. Manage data retention for X D R and Microsoft Sentinel tables, including Analytics, Data lake and X D R tiers. Create and configure Microsoft Sentinel workbooks. Optimize the Microsoft Sentinel platform, including sock optimization recommendations. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: one. Manage a security operations environment (forty to forty-five percent). Exam format: one hundred minutes; a score of seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand passes. Validated against: the official Microsoft S C-two hundred study guide and Microsoft Learn.

1.title: Sentinel roles
1.text: Sentinel roles. The figure shows this: Sentinel roles build on each other from Reader to Contributor.

1.title: Sentinel roles, continued
1.text: Sentinel roles. Microsoft Sentinel Reader. View data, incidents and workbooks. Microsoft Sentinel Responder. Reader plus manage incidents (assign, change status, tags, comments). Microsoft Sentinel Contributor. Responder plus install and update solutions and create or edit rules and other resources. Microsoft Sentinel Playbook Operator. List, view and run playbooks manually. Microsoft Sentinel Automation Contributor. Lets Sentinel add playbooks to automation rules; not for users. Workbook Reader or Workbook Contributor. View or create workbooks.

1.title: Sentinel roles, continued
1.text: Sentinel roles. Create or edit analytics rules or workbooks. Contributor, or Responder or Reader plus Workbook Contributor. Manage the Content hub. Contributor at resource group level. Best scope. Resource group level; at workspace scope you also need the roles on the Security Insights solution resource. Guest users who assign incidents. Responder plus the Entra role Directory Reader. Assignments. Cumulative. Exam tip: Reader sees, Responder works incidents, Contributor builds content. Pick the lowest role that does the job, at resource group scope. Data lake roles (Microsoft Entra): read equals Global reader, Security reader, Security operator, Security administrator, Global administrator; write, K Q L jobs and notebooks equals Security operator, Security administrator, Global administrator.

1.title: The three data tiers
1.text: The three data tiers. The figure shows this: Analytics, Data lake and X D R tiers: cost, retention and features.

1.title: The three data tiers, continued
1.text: The three data tiers. Analytics. Purpose: Interactive, hot; all real-time features (analytics rules, hunting, workbooks, playbooks). Retention: Analytics retention thirty days to two years (extra cost); total retention up to twelve years. Data lake. Purpose: Low-cost storage for large, rarely queried data. Retention: thirty days to twelve years; the data is stored only in the lake. X D R default tier. Purpose: Defender X D R tables (for example advanced hunting tables). Retention: thirty days, free; extending to ninety days costs only ingestion. Analytics data is mirrored to the data lake for the same period by default (one copy of data). Included analytics retention differs by page (ninety days for Sentinel tables, thirty days for X D R tables, with some pages showing thirty days as the base).

1.title: The three data tiers, continued
1.text: The three data tiers. Analytics rules, hunting queries, workbooks, playbooks, watchlists, parsers. Analytics tier: Yes. Data lake tier: No. Full K Q L with joins and unions, scheduled K Q L jobs, notebooks. Analytics tier: Yes. Data lake tier: Yes. Search jobs and summary rules. Analytics tier: Yes. Data lake tier: Yes. Restore and data export. Analytics tier: Yes. Data lake tier: No. Exam tip: Cheap, long, rarely queried equals Data lake. Detections and workbooks equals Analytics. Changing a table from Analytics to Data lake stops its analytics rules, alerting and hunting.

1.title: Setting retention
1.text: Setting retention. Path. Microsoft Sentinel, then Configuration, then Tables, select the table, Manage table, Save. View tables. Security data basics (read). Change tier or retention. Data (manage); Azure equivalent Log Analytics Contributor (plus Sentinel Contributor). Lowering total retention. Data stays for thirty more days before removal. Changing analytics retention. Takes effect immediately. K Q L jobs (Module seventeen) and notebooks promote data from the lake to the Analytics tier when a detection needs it.

1.title: Workbooks
1.text: Workbooks. Workbooks are Azure Monitor workbooks: each is an Azure resource with R back. They turn Sentinel data into interactive dashboards. Template. Threat management, then Workbooks, then Templates; check Required data types, then Save (saves a Jason Azure resource). Edit. View saved workbook, then Edit, then Done Editing. New. Add workbook; data source Logs; resource type Log Analytics. Roles. Workbook Reader or Workbook Contributor on the resource group; creating or deleting needs Sentinel Contributor (or lesser) plus Workbook Contributor.

1.title: Workbooks, continued
1.text: Workbooks. Save as. Clones a workbook into My workbooks; templates cannot be deleted; deleting a workbook is permanent. Auto refresh. five minutes to one day; off by default. Useful workbooks: Incident Overview, Investigation Insights, my ter attack, Security Operations Efficiency, Data collection health monitoring, Analytics Health and Audit, Workspace Usage Report, Threat Intelligence, Azure Activity. Exam tip: Data collection health monitoring shows ingestion problems; Security Operations Efficiency shows sock metrics such as time to triage and close.

1.title: SOC optimization
1.text: sock optimization. sock optimization gives recommendations to get more security value from your data and detections. Path: Defender portal, then sock optimization (Azure portal: Threat management, then sock optimization). Coverage. Threat-based, A I my ter attack, risk-based. Data value. Move or remove low-value data (for example change a table to a Basic plan).

1.title: SOC optimization, continued
1.text: sock optimization. Threat-based coverage rating. High above seventy-five percent of recommended rules active; Medium thirty to seventy-four percent; Low zero to twenty-nine percent. Refresh. Every twenty-four hours. Status. Active (default), In progress, Complete (auto-completes when no longer relevant), Dismissed; Reactivate from the Completed or Dismissed tabs (up to one hour). Actions. Go to Content hub (add analytics rules), Change plan (move a table to Basic logs), View threat scenario in my ter attack. Exam tip: A coverage recommendation is answered by adding rules from the Content hub; a data value recommendation by changing the table plan.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. An engineer must install solutions from the Content hub and edit analytics rules, with the least privilege. Which role and scope should be assigned? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Microsoft Sentinel Contributor at the resource group level. Contributor can install solutions and create or edit rules; the resource group is the recommended scope.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. Firewall logs must be kept for seven years for audit, are rarely queried and must be stored at the lowest cost. What should be configured for the table? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Data lake tier with a retention of seven years. The Data lake tier is low cost and keeps data up to twelve years.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. A table is moved from the Analytics tier to the Data lake tier. Which capability stops working for that table? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Analytics rules, alerting and hunting queries. Analytics rules, alerting and hunting need the Analytics tier.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. An analyst needs to view the tables and their tiers in the Defender portal but must not change them. Which permission fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Security data basics (read) in security operations. Viewing tables needs Security data basics (read); changing them needs Data (manage).

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. A user needs to create and delete workbooks. The user already has Microsoft Sentinel Reader. What else is needed? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Workbook Contributor on the resource group of the workspace. Creating or deleting workbooks needs Workbook Contributor.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. sock optimization shows a threat-based coverage recommendation for ransomware with missing detections. Which action adds the missing rules? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Go to Content hub and install the recommended solution rules. Coverage recommendations link to the Content hub to add analytics rules.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. Which role can manage incidents but not install solutions? Answer: Microsoft Sentinel Responder. Question two. What is the maximum total retention? Answer: twelve years. Question three. How long is free retention for X D R tables? Answer: thirty days.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. Where do you set table retention? Answer: Microsoft Sentinel, then Configuration, then Tables, then Manage table. Question five. How often do sock optimization recommendations refresh? Answer: Every twenty-four hours. Question six. What is the range of workbook auto refresh? Answer: five minutes to one day (off by default).

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Roles: Reader sees, Responder manages incidents, Contributor builds; resource group scope. Tiers: Analytics (all features), Data lake (cheap, up to twelve years), X D R (thirty days free). Move to lake: analytics rules, hunting and workbooks stop. Retention path: Configuration, then Tables, then Manage table. Workbooks: Azure Monitor resources; Workbook Contributor to create. sock optimization: coverage (Content hub) and data value (change plan); refresh twenty-four hours.
